name: violet_breath_front
for: warped_drake violet breath (Motion::Shot 11/TPS): the travelling front
notes: Loop, in place, facing +x: a rolling violet billow (two masses tumbling round a bright core, the top rolling forward) with a vapour wake streaming back, short violet-white crackles flickering on its leading face, motes and sparks shed behind. ~56 px tall = the 0.4-1.8 m band; anchor = the billow's leading core.
